source_page_excerpt: Delegation is the ability for a MetaMask smart account to grant permission to another smart contract or externally owned account (EOA) to perform specific executions on its behalf. The account that grants the permission is called the delegator account, while the account that receives the permission is called the delegate account. The Smart Accounts Kit follows the ERC-7710 standard for smart contract delegation. In addition, users can use delegation scopes and caveat enforcers to apply rules and restrictions to delegations. The delegator creates a delegation, configuring a scope and optional caveats that define the conditions under which the delegation can be redeemed. The delegator signs the delegation, producing a verifiable signature that the Delegation Manager can later validate.
